title: Environment
description: environment.json: what ran the benchmark and how each hop was secured.

pod.description: Name of the bench pod; analysis uses it to select the bench container's series.

shard_pods.description: The follower shards' bench pods of a sharded run (engine.shards), in shard order from 1; analysis treats them as bench pods too, so client_bound sees every shard's CPU.

clock_source.description: Where timestamps came from, for example ntp or host.

offline.description: servtuner run --offline: no public datasheet fallback and no AWS Price List. Absent means false.

knobs.description: The knob values the target adapter captured, by knob name (for example vllm.max_num_seqs). A knob two workloads disagreed on, or that could not be read, is absent. servtuner analyze reproduces its knob checks from this alone.

http_version.description: HTTP version of the connection to the target; when the TLS relay is used, the connection the relay makes. A client certificate makes Go's HTTP client use HTTP/1.1, so it is recorded, not assumed.

workloadInfo.description: The generated workload, so RPS is only compared between runs with the same hash.

generator.description: Name and version of the workload generator.

max_in_flight.description: The engine's cap on requests in flight at once (loadgen). When a target falls behind, in-flight requests pile up to this cap and sends wait for a slot; the analysis tells that apart from a slow client (target_saturated).

hopTransports.description: Transport mode of every hop used by this run. A hop that was not used is omitted.
